messages:
dana.design: Quick a11y sweep on the Models list — flagged a few small but important nits I ran into while keyboarding + screen reader testing. Posting short repros and suggested fixes so we can triage.
jordan.frontend: awesome — drop them here and I can take the CSS/DOM fixes for the first pass :+1:
sam.a11y: thanks! high level: focus visibility, contrast for status pills, tab order around the kebab/action menu, and an awkward SR announcement duplication.
nikita.qa: I can add automated keyboard/VO tests after we lock the fixes, will paste repro steps.
dana.design: 1) Focus ring disappears on model row when navigating with arrow keys (list supports up/down arrows to move selection). using keyboard: focus is visible on click/tab, but when using arrow navigation the focused row has no outline.
    repro: open Models > press k/j or up/down arrows to move; observe missing outline on the newly selected row.
    suggested: ensure selection state applies focus-visible style, e.g.
    ```css
    .model-row[aria-selected="true"]:focus-visible,
    .model-row--selected { outline: 3px solid #0b66ff; border-radius: 4px; }
    ```
jordan.frontend: hmm we set selection via aria-selected but don't move DOM focus, that explains it. I'll update to move focus to the new row in the arrow handler (element.focus()) and add focus-visible styles.
sam.a11y: moving real DOM focus is the right approach. Also prefer using focus-visible for keyboard only so mouse users don't get the ring.
dana.design: 2) Status/tag pills (deprecated / experimental) fail contrast at smaller sizes. "Deprecated" pill uses text #6b6b6b on background #f0f0f0 -> ~2.8:1.
    suggested: increase text weight or swap to #424242 or darker bg. target at least 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large/bold labels.
nikita.qa: I tried toggling color variables locally; `--pill-text: #2f2f2f;` + `--pill-bg: #f7f7f7;` looks much better visually.
jordan.frontend: will propose alternate tokens and show a quick before/after in the PR. should we create a semantic token like --status-pilled-text?
dana.design: 3) Tab order skips the action kebab on some rows. When tabbing through the page the row link, then page-level toolbar, then jumps past the kebab into the next row. That breaks discoverability for keyboard-only users.
    repro: open page, press Tab repeatedly from top of list; observe the kebab isn't focusable for rows added via virtualization until you interact with row.
sam.a11y: sounds like virtualization is detaching interactive controls until the row is focused. Fix: keep interactive elements tabbable (use inert or aria-hidden carefully), or provide a per-row focus trap anchor. At minimum set tabindex="0" on the kebab button when row is in viewport.
jordan.frontend: virtualization tradeoff. I'll change the renderer to always render the kebab as a button with aria-hidden toggled for visual-only clones, but keep it focusable.
nikita.qa: I'll add a keyboard walkthrough test that tabs across 10 rows and asserts each kebab receives focus.
dana.design: 4) Screen reader: VoiceOver/NVDA announces the column header twice when focusing the row. e.g., "Name, Models, row 3 of 12, Name" — duplicated header label.
    repro: VO on mac — rotor nav into list row; NVDA on Windows reports duplicated header for first cell.
sam.a11y: duplicated header often from using both aria-labelledby on cell + visible <th> referencing it. Check for aria-describedby or aria-labelledby chains we accidentally created in the row renderer. Also ensure role="row" and role="gridcell" pairing is correct when using grid/table semantics.
jordan.frontend: good catch. We added aria-labelledby to the model name cell to surface a subtitle; looks like that references the column header accidentally. I'll audit cell attributes and revert unnecessary aria-labelledby.
oliver.pm: timeline/priority? these sound P0 for keyboard users. Can we get a small patch in the next sprint?
jordan.frontend: I'll split into two PRs: focus behavior + tab order (P0) and contrast + SR attribute cleanup (P1). I can have the focus/tab PR ready in 3 business days.
sam.a11y: ping me on the PR and I'll do a quick review. I'll also add a short checklist to the models-list component docs: "move DOM focus on arrow nav", "kebab must be tabbable", "status pills meet contrast".
dana.design: last small copy nit: the kebab menu label reads "More" but VO announces only "more" — suggest aria-label="More actions for <model name>" so context is clear.
jordan.frontend: yep, will set aria-label dynamically. example: `aria-label={`More actions for ${model.name}`}`
nikita.qa: adding to tests: assert kebab has aria-label and is unique per row.
dana.design: thanks all — I'll update the design token proposal and attach screenshot comparisons in the thread.
sam.a11y: thanks, team. small, actionable fixes and good call on focus movement. I'll schedule a quick 15-min pairing session with @jordan if useful.
oliver.pm: appreciate the thoroughness — let's aim to land the focus/tab fixes this sprint. :rocket:
